title: # Build: Audio Extract plugin for AmberX (Angel profile, Opus, one session, no sub-agents) -- TOP P…
asked: # Build: Audio Extract plugin for AmberX (Angel profile, Opus, one session, no sub-agents) -- TOP PRIORITY axHub tool allowed: load CLAUDE.md, the shared + repo RULES.md and THREADS.md (claude-sync, else axhub.memory_read), then build. Branch claude/audio-extract. Brett (voice, Oct 30 2026): he screen-records his phone (Samsung Screen recorder) and wants an AmberX plugin that strips the audio out of the video into an audio file. NO live recording, NO microphone, NO fallbacks: "I don't want that shit if it has fallback." Extraction from a video file only, which always works. 1. Plugin **Audio Extract** (folder audio-extract, plugin-lifecycle@1), targets amberx-droid; installed and enabled in AmberX by default in this build. 2. Native side (apps/amberx-droid/android, own Capacitor plugin file next to AmberxNativePlugin.java; don't edit files other builds own): MediaExtractor + MediaMuxer to pull the audio track out losslessly (AAC in MP4 -> .m4a) with no re-encode, fast, no permissions beyond the file picker (MediaStore / SAF). Optional re-encode to MP3 or WAV through MediaCodec only when Brett picks that format. Trim start/end, pick a track if there are several, batch (several videos at once), progress + cancel. Output to Music/AmberX Audio via MediaStore. 3. UI in AmberX: Share-to-AmberX intent (share a video from Gallery -> extract), a Pick video button, auto-detect new screen recordings (watch Movies/Screen recordings / DCIM/Screen recordings and show a "New screen recording: extract audio?" card, opt-in setting), a results list (play, rename, share, delete), settings (format, output folder, auto-extract on/off, delete video after). Voice commands: "extract audio from my last screen recording". Theme tokens only, framework controls, phone-first. 4. Tests: AmberX tsc + test.mjs, plugin-lifecycle check, fakes for the native bridge; Android compile if the toolchain is present (note if not). Build a debug APK if possible and put it where AmberX APKs go; otherwise say exactly how Brett builds it. 5. Angel orchestrator entry (steps of 30 min or less), THREADS row, axHub change log. Push and open the PR (gh/git if the banner token 401s). Don't merge. Anything needing Brett = a veto call with a reason, never polled.
